<issue_description>
A heap-buffer-overflow in MatIO: Mat_VarPrint (src/matio/src/mat.c) calls printf/vprintf on a variable name buffer that is not guaranteed to be NUL-terminated (the buffer allocated in Mat_VarReadNextInfo4 in src/matio/src/mat4.c is 32 bytes). printf reads past the end of the allocated buffer (one byte over), causing a heap out-of-bounds read that can crash the program or lead to memory corruption and possible information disclosure or other exploitation.

import cpp

from FunctionCall call, Function f, StringLiteral fmt
where
  call.getTarget() = f and f.getName() = "printf" and
  fmt = call.getArgument(0) and
  fmt.getValue().regexpMatch("(?s).*%s.*") and
  call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath() = "src/mat.c"
select call, "printf uses %s; ensure the corresponding string argument is NUL-terminated."

import cpp

from FunctionCall call, Function f, StringLiteral fmt
where
  call.getTarget() = f and f.getName() = "printf" and
  fmt = call.getArgument(0) and
  fmt.getValue().regexpMatch("(?s).*%s.*") and
  call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath() = "src/mat.c"
select call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath(), call.getLocation().getStartLine(),
  "printf uses %s; ensure the corresponding argument is NUL-terminated."

import cpp

from FunctionCall m, Expr lhs
where
  m.getTarget().getName() = "malloc" and
  m.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath() = "src/mat4.c" and
  exists(AssignExpr a |
    a.getRhs() = m and lhs = a.getLhs()
  )
select m.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath(), m.getLocation().getStartLine(),
  "malloc result may hold non-NUL-terminated data later used as a C-string (check for +1 and terminator)."
